summary: John's 7th-great-grandfather; Lutheran villager of Jettenbach in the Palatinate.
bio: Born about 1694 at Jettenbach, confirmed 1707, married Elisabetha Margaretha Lampert there on 16 Apr 1720, died at Jettenbach 7 Feb 1763. Children: Johann Jacob (1722), Johann Peter (1724, the Windsor 1753 immigrant), Andreas (1727), Nicol (1729), Maria Elisabetha (1730), Elisabetha Margaretha (1732), Johann Philipp (1737).
